title: Olu Ndị Na-efe Chineke n'akụkụ Onye Amụma
intro: N'ala dị anya, otu onye ozi a ma ama zutere ajọ mbunobi site n'aka ndị ọchịchị nke oge ahụ. Ma obere ìgwè mkpụrụ obi raara onwe ha nye guzoro n'akụkụ ohu Allah a, na-achọsi ike ịza oku Chineke. Nkwenye ha na-enweghị isi ga-ekewa mba dị ike ma mechaa merie ike nke ekweghị ekwe.
clues: Anyị bụ obere otu ndị raara onwe ha nye, ndị dị n'otu n'okwukwe na nzube.
Anyị guzoro n'akụkụ otu onye ozi dị ebube nke ndị ọchịchị dị ike nke ala ha jụrụ.
Mgbe onye ozi a jụrụ, 'Ònye bụ ndị na-akwado m n'ụzọ Allah?' anyị zara n'egbughị oge.
Anyị rịọrọ onye ozi a ka ọ chọọ oriri site n'eluigwe iji mee ka obi sie anyị ike.
N'etiti ndị oge ahụ, ụfọdụ kwere site na ozi anyị, ebe ndị ọzọ jụrụ isi ike, mana Allah mere ka ndị kwere ekwe sie ike.
Anyị bụ ndị Hawarịyun — ndị na-eso ụzọ Isa raara onwe ha nye, ndị e mere ka ha merie site n'enyemaka Allah.

Ndị Enyi nke Ọgba ahụ

Ezinụlọ Eze nke Saba

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
